ambient_events: A flask is lifted, held to the lamp, turned once, and set back in its felt.
The thermometer is read and a number is written and initialled.
She lays both hands flat on a rack and holds them there a while.
description: Half sunk into the ground with a turf roof and a heavy door set into the slope, and a padlock on it that is the only padlock in the Thornwarren. A thermometer on the frame and a log on a string, read four times a day, and the log is signed.
name: The Milkhouse
